##### Project general facts

PG Maison is a boutique contemporary development created for families who want a calm and elevated everyday life. With only eighty exclusive residences and just four homes on each floor, the building offers a rare sense of privacy, serenity and closeness. The collection centres on beautifully designed two-bedroom apartments, each with a fully equipped kitchen, a versatile study or home office, and its own expansive private balcony.

Life here feels like a permanent retreat, with an infinity swimming pool, a rooftop swimming pool, a dedicated children's pool, a jacuzzi and a roof terrace with private seating. Active residents are spoilt for choice thanks to a fully equipped gym, a serene yoga studio, a squash court, a jogging loop and a rooftop padel court with wonderful panoramic views. Families also enjoy a kids' play area, an outdoor BBQ area, ground floor retail, a pet friendly environment, concierge service, home automation, CCTV and high speed connectivity throughout.

Inside, natural light floods the living spaces and highlights a refined, stylish colour scheme and continuous wooden herringbone flooring that flows gracefully from room to room. Every bedroom comes with an en-suite bathroom and clever integrated storage, including built-in wardrobes with sliding doors that make the most of every corner. The complete kitchen is furnished with a built-in washer and dryer, a refrigerator and freezer and a gas oven with hob, while luxurious furnishings and carefully selected materials give each residence a warm and polished finish.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
